welcome_page.title: Walking – Road safety
welcome_page.image_alt: #Person walking and a route between two points
welcome_page.description:
Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and obstacles when you walk. Each question has two answers: Yes or No.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: When you walk along roads with fast or heavy traffic, do you feel unsafe?
When you cross roads with fast or heavy traffic on foot, do you feel unsafe?
Do you avoid some roads or crossings because you cannot cross them safely on foot?
While walking, do you feel unsafe when cyclists or e-scooter riders pass close to you?
While walking, do poor sidewalk conditions (e.g., holes, uneven surfaces, or crumbling edges) make you feel unsafe?
Do obstacles on the sidewalk (e.g., roadworks, bins, or parked scooters) force you to change your path or walk closer to traffic?
When you walk, do car drivers make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do motorcycle or scooter riders make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do bus drivers make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do delivery vehicles (vans, cargo bikes, scooters) make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do taxi or ride-hailing drivers make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do cyclists make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do e-scooter riders make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do other pedestrians make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do poor visibility or limited sightlines make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, does unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, do crowding or conflicts with other road users make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, does the lack of safe or adequate sidewalks, crossings or lighting make you feel unsafe?
When you walk, does the absence of emergency services make you feel unsafe?
On your walking route, are there steps or steep curbs without ramps?
On your walking route, are dropped kerbs at crossings missing or broken?
On your walking route, are there paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stroller, or two people to pass?
On your walking route, is tactile paving for visually impaired people missing or broken?
On your walking route, are there low branches or bushes taking up space?
On your walking route, are stairs the only way through, or are stairways closed?
On your walking route, are there stretches with no sidewalk, so you have to walk in the road?
On your walking route, are pedestrian traffic lights out of order?

it.#When you walk along roads with fast or: Quando cammini lungo strade con traffico veloce o intenso, ti senti in pericolo?
it.#When you cross roads with fast or heavy: Quando attraversi a piedi strade con traffico veloce o intenso, ti senti in pericolo?
it.#Do you avoid some roads or crossings be: Eviti alcune strade o attraversamenti perché a piedi non riesci ad attraversarli in sicurezza?
it.#While walking, do you feel unsafe when: Quando cammini, ti senti in pericolo se chi va in bici o in monopattino elettrico ti passa vicino?
it.#While walking, do poor sidewalk conditi: Quando cammini, i marciapiedi in cattivo stato (es. buche, superfici irregolari o bordi sgretolati) ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#Do obstacles on the sidewalk (e.g., roa: Gli ostacoli sul marciapiede (es. lavori stradali, cassonetti o monopattini parcheggiati) ti costringono a cambiare percorso o a camminare più vicino al traffico?
it.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: Quando cammini, chi guida l’auto ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do motorcycle or scooter: Quando cammini, chi guida moto o scooter ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do bus drivers make you: Quando cammini, chi guida l’autobus ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do delivery vehicles (va: Quando cammini, i veicoli per le consegne (furgoni, cargo bike, scooter) ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do taxi or ride-hailing: Quando cammini, chi guida taxi o servizi di ride-hailing ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do cyclists make you fee: Quando cammini, chi va in bicicletta ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do e-scooter riders make: Quando cammini, chi va in monopattino elettrico ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do other pedestrians mak: Quando cammini, altre persone a piedi ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do poor visibility or li: Quando cammini, la scarsa visibilità o la visuale limitata ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: Quando cammini, i comportamenti pericolosi di chi guida, di chi pedala o di chi va a piedi ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, do crowding or conflicts: Quando cammini, l’affollamento o i conflitti con altri utenti della strada ti fanno sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, does the lack of safe or: Quando cammini, la mancanza di marciapiedi, attraversamenti o illuminazione sicuri e adeguati ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#When you walk, does the absence of emer: Quando cammini, l’assenza di servizi di emergenza ti fa sentire in pericolo?
it.#On your walking route, are there steps: Sul tuo percorso a piedi ci sono gradini o cordoli alti senza rampe?
it.#On your walking route, are dropped kerb: Sul tuo percorso a piedi mancano o sono rotti gli scivoli dei marciapiedi agli attraversamenti?
it.#On your walking route, are there paths: Sul tuo percorso a piedi ci sono passaggi troppo stretti per una sedia a rotelle, un passeggino o due persone?
it.#On your walking route, is tactile pavin: Sul tuo percorso a piedi i percorsi tattili per persone con disabilità visiva mancano o sono rotti?
it.#On your walking route, are there low br: Sul tuo percorso a piedi ci sono rami bassi o cespugli che occupano spazio?
it.#On your walking route, are stairs the o: Sul tuo percorso a piedi le scale sono l’unico passaggio, oppure le scalinate sono chiuse?
it.#On your walking route, are there stretc: Sul tuo percorso a piedi ci sono tratti senza marciapiede, dove devi camminare sulla strada?
it.#On your walking route, are pedestrian t: Sul tuo percorso a piedi ci sono semafori pedonali guasti?
it.#Person walking and a route between two: Persona che cammina e un percorso tra due punti
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and ob:
Traffico, attraversamenti, marciapiedi e ostacoli quando cammini. Ogni domanda ha due risposte: Sì o No.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#When you walk along roads with fast or: Lorsque vous marchez le long de routes à circulation rapide ou dense, vous sentez-vous en danger ?
fr.#When you cross roads with fast or heavy: Lorsque vous traversez à pied des routes à circulation rapide ou dense, vous sentez-vous en danger ?
fr.#Do you avoid some roads or crossings be: Évitez-vous certaines routes ou certains passages parce que vous ne pouvez pas les traverser à pied en sécurité ?
fr.#While walking, do you feel unsafe when: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger quand des cyclistes ou des personnes en trottinette électrique passent près de vous ?
fr.#While walking, do poor sidewalk conditi: Lorsque vous marchez, le mauvais état des trottoirs (par ex. trous, surfaces irrégulières ou bords effrités) vous fait-il sentir en danger ?
fr.#Do obstacles on the sidewalk (e.g., roa: Les obstacles sur le trottoir (par ex. travaux, poubelles ou trottinettes garées) vous obligent-ils à changer de trajet ou à marcher plus près de la circulation ?
fr.#When you walk, do car drivers make you: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent une voiture ?
fr.#When you walk, do motorcycle or scooter: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes à moto ou en scooter ?
fr.#When you walk, do bus drivers make you: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent un bus ?
fr.#When you walk, do delivery vehicles (va: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des véhicules de livraison (fourgonnettes, vélos cargo, scooters) ?
fr.#When you walk, do taxi or ride-hailing: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes qui conduisent un taxi ou un VTC ?
fr.#When you walk, do cyclists make you fee: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des cyclistes ?
fr.#When you walk, do e-scooter riders make: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause des personnes en trottinette électrique ?
fr.#When you walk, do other pedestrians mak: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause d’autres personnes à pied ?
fr.#When you walk, do poor visibility or li: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause d’une mauvaise visibilité ou d’un champ de vision limité ?
fr.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de comportements dangereux de personnes qui conduisent, qui roulent ou qui marchent ?
fr.#When you walk, do crowding or conflicts: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de la foule ou de conflits avec d’autres personnes sur la route ?
fr.#When you walk, does the lack of safe or: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause du manque de trottoirs, de passages ou d’éclairage sûrs et adaptés ?
fr.#When you walk, does the absence of emer: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de l’absence de services d’urgence ?
fr.#On your walking route, are there steps: Sur votre trajet à pied, y a-t-il des marches ou des bordures hautes sans rampe ?
fr.#On your walking route, are dropped kerb: Sur votre trajet à pied, les bateaux de trottoir aux passages piétons manquent-ils ou sont-ils abîmés ?
fr.#On your walking route, are there paths: Sur votre trajet à pied, y a-t-il des passages trop étroits pour un fauteuil roulant, une poussette ou deux personnes ?
fr.#On your walking route, is tactile pavin: Sur votre trajet à pied, les bandes podotactiles pour les personnes malvoyantes manquent-elles ou sont-elles abîmées ?
fr.#On your walking route, are there low br: Sur votre trajet à pied, y a-t-il des branches basses ou des buissons qui prennent de la place ?
fr.#On your walking route, are stairs the o: Sur votre trajet à pied, les escaliers sont-ils le seul passage possible, ou des escaliers sont-ils fermés ?
fr.#On your walking route, are there stretc: Sur votre trajet à pied, y a-t-il des tronçons sans trottoir, où il faut marcher sur la chaussée ?
fr.#On your walking route, are pedestrian t: Sur votre trajet à pied, des feux pour piétons sont-ils en panne ?
fr.#Person walking and a route between two: Personne à pied et un itinéraire entre deux points
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and ob:
La circulation, les passages piétons, les trottoirs et les obstacles lorsque vous marchez. Chaque question a deux réponses : Oui ou Non.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom. Indiquer votre adresse e-mail est facultatif ; les informations sur la protection des données de SmartUrbanity expliquent comment elle est protégée et comment vos réponses sont utilisées.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#When you walk, do crowding or conflicts: Fühlen Sie sich beim Gehen durch Gedränge oder Konflikte mit anderen Verkehrsteilnehmenden unsicher?

de.#Person walking and a route between two: Gehende Person und eine Route zwischen zwei Punkten
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#<p>Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and ob:
Verkehr, Überwege, Gehwege und Hindernisse, wenn Sie zu Fuß unterwegs sind. Jede Frage hat zwei Antworten: Ja oder Nein.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und Sie können jede Frage überspringen. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft. Die Angabe Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse ist freiwillig; die Datenschutzhinweise von SmartUrbanity erklären, wie sie geschützt wird und wie Ihre Antworten verwendet werden.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren

tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#<p>Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and ob:
Yürürken trafik, yaya geçitleri, kaldırımlar ve engeller. Her sorunun iki cevabı var: Evet veya Hayır.

Katılım gönüllüdür ve istediğiniz soruyu atlayabilirsiniz. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez. E-posta adresi vermek isteğe bağlıdır; SmartUrbanity gizlilik bildirimi bunun nasıl korunduğunu ve yanıtların nasıl kullanıldığını açıklar.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin
